## A quick checklist
 - Target gmoddev/CCLuau main only. Fork changes are never submitted to upstream for merging.
 - Read AGENTS.md and link relevant invariants and qualification evidence. AI-assisted work is accepted here.
 - If there's a existing issue, please link to it. If not, provide fill out the same information you would in a normal issue - reproduction steps for bugs, rationale for use-case.
 - If you're working on CraftOS, verify relevant behavior. Tests live in `projects/core/src/test/resources/test-rom/spec` and can be run with `./gradlew :core:test`.
